desc: Damage dealt by Geode Barrage and Seismic Spike now strikes up to 2 additional enemies.

name: Terrasurge
desc: Unleash a massive globule of earth at an enemy, dealing its value Physical damage and reducing their Armor by % for sec. Pierces through absorption, deflection, and reflection effects. Deals % additional damage for each Earthshaping stack.

name: The Chosen One
desc: Earthmother's Chosen now also increases your critical strike chance by %.

name: Therazane's Gift
desc: Therazane's Rage now generates an additional Rage and % additional mana.

name: Therazane's Might
desc: Your Terrasurge will now always critically strike against targets affected by your Seismic Tremor.

name: Therazane's Rage
desc: Generates % maximum mana and Rage, plus an additional Rage and its value mana every sec.

name: Throat Clamp
desc: Command your pet to dash forward a short distance towards your target, interrupting spellcasting and preventing any spell in that school from being cast.

name: Tide's Favor
desc: Reduces the Rage cost of Hammer of Life.

name: Torn to Shreds
desc: Totemic Smash and Rylak's Bite now causes enemies to bleed for its value over, stacking 2 times.

name: Totem Warrior
desc: While you have Boon of the Bear active, Wildclaw will now strike an additional time for % of the damage dealt with both weapons.

name: Totemic Smash
desc: Smash an enemy for % Weapon Damage plus its value. Deals an additional its value damage to up to enemies within yds.

name: Traumatic Wounds
desc: Critical strikes with Wildclaw now causes your target to bleed for 100% of the damage dealt over.

name: Tremors
desc: Level 30 Passive Periodic damage now has a % chance to reset the cooldown of your |CffffffffSeismic abilties and cause your next cast within to be free of cost.

name: Tribalism
desc: Damage dealt by Wildclaw now increases you and your Spirit pet's critical strike chance by %, stacking times.

name: Unstable Fracture
desc: Erect a mighty pillar of earth from beneath an enemy, inflicting its value Nature damage to up to enemies within yds, splitting the damage evenly amongst all enemies.

name: Untamed
desc: Increases the range of Primal Rush by 3 yds.

name: Unyielding Form
desc: Increases your parry and dodge chance by % and your Armor contribution from mail and plate by %.

name: Ursoc's Bellow
desc: Bellow with the might of Ursoc, reduce attack power of enemies within yds by.

name: Volcanic Blast
desc: Your Physical or Nature damaging critical strikes now deal an additional % of the damage dealt as Fire damage to the target and enemies nearby.

name: Waters of Neptulon
desc: 2 Charges 10 sec recharge Unleash soothing water, healing up to allies within yds. Active Boons are extended by sec.

name: Wild Warrior
desc: Level 20 Passive Damage dealt by Wildclaw or Quake now reduces the cooldown of Seismic abilities by sec.

name: Wildaxe
desc: Strike an enemy, dealing its value Physical damage with both weapons, and causing a special effect based on your active pet. Dealing direct Physical damage reduces the remaining cooldown of this ability by sec.

name: Wildclaw
desc: Strike with both weapons, dealing Weapon Damage plus its value.

name: Wildfury
desc: Casting Wildshape now restores % of your maximum health.

name: Wildheart
desc: The Earthmother marks you as her chosen one, reducing the cooldown of all other non-damaging spells and abilities by %, repeating every sec. Instantly restores % missing health, mana, and Rage to you, repeating every sec.

name: Wildmend
desc: Heals an ally, scaling with your attack power and healing spell power. Any effects that impact your Ruptured Earth ability also affect this spell.

name: Wildwalking
desc: Increases Agility and movement speed by %.

name: Wildwalking Primalist
desc: Teaches Tame Beast, allowing you to tame beasts throughout Azeroth to be your companion.

name: World Shaper
desc: Every sec, you passively gain a stack of World Shaper, stacking 5 times. In addition, your direct damage dealt now has a % chance to generate a stack of |CffffffffWorldshaper.
